title: Finds improper usages of XCTAssertEqual and XCTAssertNotEqual and replaces them with XCTAssertEqualObjects or XCTAssertNotEqualObjects.
summary: clang-tidy can fix the code that it finds. The check is in the objc module of clang-tidy.

title: Finds improper initialization of NSError objects.
summary: The check is in the objc module of clang-tidy.

title: Finds implementations of -dealloc in Objective-C categories.
summary: The category implementation will override any -dealloc in the class implementation, potentially causing issues. The check is in the objc module of clang-tidy.

title: Finds Objective-C classes which are subclasses of classes which are not designed to be subclassed.
summary: The check is in the objc module of clang-tidy.

title: Finds Objective-C implementations that implement -isEqual: without also appropriately implementing -hash.
summary: The check is in the objc module of clang-tidy.

title: When NSDateFormatter is used to convert an NSDate type to a String type, the user can specify a custom format string.
summary: Certain format specifiers are undesirable despite being legal. See http://www.unicode.org/reports/tr35/tr35-dates.html#Date_Format_Patterns for all legal date patterns. The check is in the objc module of clang-tidy.

title: Finds calls to NSInvocation methods under ARC that don't have proper argument object lifetimes.
summary: When passing Objective-C objects as parameters to the NSInvocation methods getArgument:atIndex: and getReturnValue:, the values are copied by value into the argument pointer, which leads to incorrect releasing behavior if the object pointers are not declared __unsafe_unretained. clang-tidy can fix the code that it finds. The check is in the objc module of clang-tidy.

title: Finds property declarations in Objective-C files that do not follow the pattern of property names in Apple's programming guide.
summary: The property name should be in the format of Lower Camel Case. clang-tidy can fix the code that it finds. The check is in the objc module of clang-tidy.

title: Finds invocations of -self on super instances in initializers of subclasses of NSObject and recommends calling a superclass initializer instead.
summary: clang-tidy can fix the code that it finds. The check is in the objc module of clang-tidy.
